description: This file defines a Perl ResultSet class for 'User' entities within the Coocook schema, including methods for validation, availability checks, and query helpers.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::User
classes.description: A ResultSet class for performing database operations related to 'User' entities, with custom methods for validation and querying.

methods.name: sorted_by_columns
methods.description: Returns the default column for sorting users, which is 'name_fc'.

methods.name: email_valid_and_available
methods.description: Checks if an email is valid, not blacklisted, and not already associated with a pending token.

methods.name: name_available
methods.description: Checks if a username is available, not blacklisted, and not used by an organization.

methods.name: with_projects_count
methods.description: Retrieves users along with a count of their owned projects.

methods.name: with_valid_limited_token
methods.description: Retrieves users with a valid, limited token that has not expired.

methods.name: with_valid_or_unlimited_token
methods.description: Retrieves users with either no token expiration or a valid, unexpired token.
